title: APC-1 authenticated preprocessing and amortized online execution
question: Can a one-time independently appraisable capsule prove that Q=G^T M belongs to the exact committed model/layout, then reduce repeated online verifier cost without weakening the E-009 execution relation or hiding setup, privacy, update, and recovery costs?

frozen_inputs.value: sha256:a0bd41c056b4b1521e54eb9688e86e4b2452f2fab7097ed606eb1d54dafd2117; superseded before preregistration because it misstated direct Q recomputation arithmetic as an entry-count bound

procedure: Freeze a public matrix/layout family, exact byte-to-field transform, code generator, Q format, and immutable model/setup roots.
Generate one setup capsule proving or conditionally attesting Q=G^T M under the selected lane; retain setup prover, verifier, proof, byte, memory, and update costs.
Verify repeated E-009-style online matrix events against the capsule for preregistered request counts K, preserving event, request, cache, output, and challenge ordering.
Compare deterministic full-Q recomputation, the selected capsule lane, and one complete proof baseline over identical matrices and request rows.
Apply every model/layout/Q/generator/revision/challenge/membership/output/coordinate mutation independently and retain rejection codes.
Report setup and online provider, client/challenger, verifier, network, storage, privacy, update, revocation, and recovery costs without hypothetical amortization replacing observed K.
acceptance: A separate setup verifier binds Q to the exact model/layout root and rejects each one-field model, layout, generator, Q, and revision substitution.
A separate online verifier accepts the unmodified repeated execution set without reading every M or Q entry per request and preserves complete event and request-membership coverage.
The challenge analysis includes the exact public beacon, interaction, or Fiat-Shamir query/grinding model rather than reporting only the base code-distance bound.
Observed total cost is reported at every frozen K and compared with deterministic recomputation and one complete proof baseline on identical work.
Any Pearl adapter, if included, consumes actual native version-pinned roots and remains separate from the capsule core and four-coordinate appraisal.
failure: Any accepted Q not derived from the exact committed model/layout falsifies APC-1.
Any online verifier that must touch the full matrices for every request fails the intended asymptotic/amortization question, even if correct.
Any apparent advantage that omits setup, proof generation, updates, verifier preprocessing, bytes, privacy, or recovery is incomplete.
Any reused capsule across an incompatible model, adapter, quantization, layout, shard, generator, or revocation epoch invalidates the run.
Any native-Pearl, hardware, privacy, demand, or production claim without its exact relation and retained evidence invalidates the result.
known_bad_controls: Change one model field element while retaining C_Q and the setup proof.
Change one Q field element while retaining the model root and setup proof.
Change dtype, quantization, tensor layout, shard, padding, or generator version without issuing a new capsule.
Replay a valid capsule under a different model or revocation epoch.
Choose the setup or online challenge before the corresponding commitments are fixed.
Graft one batched row or cache parent across jobs while preserving aggregate dimensions.
Replace one final output after the online subject is fixed.
Relabel an auditor/TEE/setup commitment as cryptographic execution or native Pearl WORK.
blocking_conditions: No setup proof, PCS/sumcheck, independent-auditor, or attestation lane has been selected and justified.
No matrix family, layout, field, generator, privacy policy, challenge source, query bound, amortization schedule, or comparator has been frozen.
No separate setup and online verifier implementations have been designated.
No operator acceptance of an E-010 preregistration exists.
